description:
Everyone talks about having a Plan B.

Almost no one talks about what it costs you.

Because every ounce of energy you spend protecting your escape route is energy you’re not investing in making Plan A work.

The people who change their lives don’t have more confidence.

They simply stop giving themselves permission to quit.

Burning the boats isn’t about being reckless.

It’s about making a decision so real that your mind stops looking backward and starts solving the problem in front of you.

Commitment creates resourcefulness.

When quitting is no longer an option, you start finding options you never would have seen before.

The life you want is usually on the other side of a decision you’ve been avoiding.

Burn the boats.

Then build the bridge.
transcript: you want to accomplish something big, something out of your comfort zone, that next level that you've been craving, then screw plan B. Make everything, all of your energy plan A. Burn the boats, knock the wall down, go through the pain, go through whatever it takes, and put all the focuses like, no, there's no plan B. This is my life.
